_comment: PLACEHOLDER. Astra's daily mood check: 3 of these are picked per astronaut per mission day (backend/logic/mood_check.py) and asked aloud. Open questions, answered in your own words; the AI judges mood from the words plus the voice tone. Not a clinical instrument.
questions: How are you feeling right now, in a few words?
How did you sleep last night?
What has been the best part of your day so far?
Is anything worrying you today?
How is your energy right now?
How are you getting on with the rest of the crew today?
What are you looking forward to?
How heavy does your workload feel today?
Did anything frustrate you today?
How is your body feeling: any aches or tiredness?
What made you smile recently?
How focused do you feel at the moment?
Is there anything you miss from home today?
How relaxed do you feel right now?
What would make tomorrow better than today?
How did your last task go?
Have you had a moment for yourself today?
How would you describe your mood in one word, and why?
Is anything keeping your mind busy?
How well are you eating and drinking today?
What's one thing you're proud of this week?
How patient do you feel with people today?
Do you feel rested or worn out?
How is your motivation for the rest of the day?
What's the view out the window like for you today?
Has anything surprised you today?
How calm do you feel when you think about tomorrow?
Who did you talk to today, and how was it?
What would you like the flight surgeon to know about your day?
How are you, honestly?
